title: EvalResult
description: Result of a single flag evaluation. Returned by `evaluate()` — no reasoning trace included.

flag_key.description: Echoes the EvalRequest.flag_key (for correlation when batches return out-of-order).

variant_key.description: Key of the variant returned. For `outcome = "flag_not_found"`, this is empty string.

value.description: Typed value of the returned variant.

oneOf.description: JSON-typed variant. Implementations MAY surface as a parsed object or as a string depending on idiomatic conventions.
